title: VerseCore
description: An enterprise-grade, high-performance All-in-One server core optimized for Paper and Folia, unifying economy, crystal PvP, secure trading, and client-side waypoints asynchronously.
body:
# ⭐ VerseCore | Ultimate Asynchronous Server Engine ⭐

VerseCore is an enterprise-grade, high-performance All-in-One server core designed specifically for modern Paper and Folia servers. Built from the ground up utilizing asynchronous processing and regional scheduling, it guarantees a rock-solid 20 TPS even under heavy player loads. Say goodbye to cluttering your server with 20+ separate plugins.

---

### 💰 Economy & Commerce
![Economy](https://i.ibb.co/TMNr4pJy/verse1.png)

* **Dual Economy & Shards:** Built-in high-performance management for primary Cash (`/money`) and premium secondary currency (`/shards`). Full PlaceholderAPI support included.
* **Anti-Scam Billford Trading (`/trade`):** An interactive split-screen interface for players to securely exchange items, money, and shards with double-confirmation protection.
* **Dynamic Category Shop:** A highly configurable GUI-based server shop menu split by item categories, featuring a premium Shard Shop setup.
* **Worth Analytics:** Real-time valuation engine that inspects items and entire Shulker Boxes instantly upon hover.

---

### ⚔️ PvP & Core Utilities
![PvP and Utilities](https://i.ibb.co/Rpxt4S7g/verse.png)

* **Fast Crystal PvP:** Packet-level optimization for hyper-responsive, fluid, and latency-free End Crystal placement and detonation cycles (DonutSMP Style).
* **Smart ClearLag System:** Automated item and entity garbage collection with customizable chat countdown alerts and strict whitelisting.
* **6-Row EnderChest (`/echest`):** Overwrites the vanilla layout into a massive 54-slot expanded personal storage system, saved securely using Base64 data strings.
* **Advanced Bounty System:** Set bounties on your rivals with server-wide chat announcements and a clean, interactive Chest GUI menu (`/bounties`).
* **Amethyst Tools & Items:** Built-in custom progression tools seamlessly integrated with server mechanics.

---

### 🗺️ Navigation, Social & Databases
![Navigation and Backend](https://i.ibb.co/1xy1FQ5/verse2.png)

* **HUD Waypoints:** Full integration with Lunar Client API and Feather Launcher channels. Teammates can see each other's 3D positions and distances live on their screen.
* **Hover Stats & Profiles:** Hovering over a player's name renders an interactive statistics card. Clicking opens their public GUI Profile (`/profile`). Includes admin Stats Wipe tools.
* **Safe RTP & Portals:** Step into custom portal regions at spawn or type `/rtp` to open a world selection menu with a surface-safety checker.
* **Spawn & AFK Zones:** Visual, book-and-icon decorated GUI menus for server navigation based on cuboid region definitions.
* **Multi-Database Backend:** Switch storage formats seamlessly within your config. Natively supports SQLite (local), MySQL (cross-server sync), and MongoDB.
